visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Footer sits beside the content
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The footer should span the bottom of the page, but it only fills the right column and the menu runs down beside it. A name in the last row of the area map is wrong.

solution.explanation: Each quoted string is a row and each word a cell. Writing side in both rows makes the sidebar span two rows, so the footer is left with only the second column. Writing foot twice makes the footer span both columns.
